marketImplications.side: Tigers is more coherent as a side because the game shape mostly agrees with the projection.
marketImplications.first5: First-five can stay live if starter hold and top-order pressure both agree.
marketImplications.total: Over is allowed only if RF/totals backtest agrees with the line bucket.
marketImplications.firstInning: YRFI is the timing lane to compare against the side; modeled chance 82.2% YRFI.

rfLens.trustedUse: Use RF as a nonlinear totals/game-shape check first. Do not let it pick ML/F5 by itself yet.
rfLens.totalsRead: RF totals baseline can be used as a second check on the posted total.
rfLens.moneylineRead: RF moneyline history is not deployable; it can only flag disagreement for review.
rfLens.first5Read: RF first-five history is not deployable; use it as a timing warning, not a pick.
rfLens.firstInningRead: RF first-inning history is not deployable; keep it behind explicit early-run features.
